preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
The lengths of strings a and b are between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ascii_uppercase for c in a) and all(c in ascii_uppercase for c in b)
preconditions.description: Both strings a and b contain only uppercase letters.

postconditions.description: The result is the lexicographically minimal string made from the letters of a and b, using the rules of the task.
